title: Admin - Prevent Unauthorized Access - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - Prevent Unauthorized Access feature on the Y4J platform. This feature restricts admin management actions (add admins, edit roles, edit permissions) to Super Admins only. Limited-access admins cannot access the User & Roles module, and unauthorized access returns an error message. Edge cases include manual URL entry, token expiration, and permission mismatch due to caching.

testCases.title: Super Admin can access User & Roles module
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles from the sidebar
expectedResults: The User & Roles page loads successfully
The admin list is displayed
No access denied error is shown
All management controls are visible (Add Internal Admin, Edit Permissions, role dropdown)
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin has full access to User & Roles module

testCases.title: Super Admin can add admins
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded.
expectedResults: The 'Add Internal Admin' button is visible and clickable
Clicking it opens the Add Internal Admin modal
The Super Admin can fill in the form and create a new admin
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin can successfully add admins

testCases.title: Super Admin can edit roles
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded with admin cards.
steps: Find an admin card with a role dropdown
expectedResults: The role dropdown is visible and interactive on admin cards
Clicking it shows role options (Super Admin, Limited-Access Admin)
The Super Admin can change an admin's role
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin can edit admin roles

testCases.title: Super Admin can edit permissions
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded with admin cards.
steps: Find an admin card with 'Edit Permissions' button
expectedResults: The 'Edit Permissions' button is visible on admin cards
Clicking it opens the permissions editor
The Super Admin can modify and save permissions
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin can edit admin permissions

testCases.title: Limited-Access Admin cannot access User & Roles module via navigation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a Limited-Access Admin.
steps: Log in as a Limited-Access Admin
Look for 'User & Roles' link in the sidebar
expectedResults: The 'User & Roles' link is NOT visible in the sidebar navigation
OR the link is visible but disabled/greyed out
The Limited-Access Admin cannot navigate to the User & Roles module via normal navigation
Only modules the admin has permission for are shown in the sidebar
testCases.postconditions: Limited-Access Admin cannot see or access User & Roles via navigation

testCases.title: Limited-Access Admin cannot access User & Roles via direct URL
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a Limited-Access Admin.
steps: Log in as a Limited-Access Admin
expectedResults: The User & Roles page does NOT load
An error/access denied message is displayed (e.g., 'You do not have permission to access this page')
OR the user is redirected to their dashboard/home page
No admin management controls are accessible
The system prevents unauthorized access even via direct URL
testCases.postconditions: Direct URL access is blocked for unauthorized users

testCases.title: Unauthorized access returns clear error message
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a Limited-Access Admin. Attempting to access User & Roles.
steps: Log in as a Limited-Access Admin
Attempt to access the User & Roles module (via URL or any method)
expectedResults: A clear error message is displayed
The message indicates the user does not have permission (e.g., 'Access Denied' or 'You do not have permission to access this page')
The message is user-friendly (not a technical error or stack trace)
The user is not left on a blank/broken page
testCases.postconditions: Clear error message is shown for unauthorized access

testCases.title: Limited-Access Admin cannot add admins via API manipulation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a Limited-Access Admin. Developer tools are open.
steps: Log in as a Limited-Access Admin
Attempt to call the admin creation API endpoint directly (e.g., via fetch/XHR)
expectedResults: The API returns a 403 Forbidden or 401 Unauthorized response
No admin is created in the system
The backend enforces authorization regardless of frontend restrictions
The error response is clear and does not expose sensitive information
testCases.postconditions: Backend API enforces authorization for admin creation

testCases.title: Token expiration redirects to login
testCases.preconditions: User was logged in as Super Admin. Session token has expired.
steps: Wait for the session token to expire (or manually invalidate it)
Attempt to perform an action (e.g., click Add Internal Admin)
expectedResults: The system detects the expired token
An appropriate message is shown (e.g., 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.')
The user is redirected to the login page
No admin management action is performed with an expired token
After re-login, the user can access User & Roles again
testCases.postconditions: Expired token is handled securely with redirect to login

testCases.title: Permission mismatch due to caching is handled correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Their role is about to be downgraded by another Super Admin.
steps: User A is logged in as Super Admin on the User & Roles page
User B (another Super Admin) downgrades User A to Limited-Access Admin
User A (still on the page with cached permissions) attempts to add a new admin
expectedResults: The system detects the permission mismatch on the API call
An error message is displayed (e.g., 'Your permissions have changed. Please refresh the page.')
The action is NOT performed (no admin is created)
After refresh, User A no longer has access to User & Roles
The system does not rely solely on cached frontend permissions
testCases.postconditions: Permission mismatch is detected and handled securely

testCases.title: Limited-Access Admin with User Management permission still cannot access User & Roles
testCases.preconditions: A Limited-Access Admin exists with 'User Management' permission assigned.
steps: Log in as the Limited-Access Admin who has 'User Management' permission
Attempt to navigate to User & Roles module
expectedResults: Even with 'User Management' permission, a Limited-Access Admin CANNOT access the full User & Roles admin management page
OR if they can view the page, they cannot add/edit/delete admins
The system distinguishes between 'User Management' permission (for their allowed scope) and full admin management (Super Admin only)
testCases.postconditions: User Management permission does not grant full admin management access

testCases.title: Vendor/Partner user cannot access admin User & Roles
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a Vendor/Partner (not an admin at all).
steps: Log in as a Vendor/Partner user
expectedResults: The Vendor/Partner user cannot access the admin User & Roles page
They are redirected to their own portal or shown an access denied message
No admin data is exposed to non-admin users
The system enforces role-based access at the highest level
testCases.postconditions: Non-admin users cannot access admin management pages

testCases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot access User & Roles
testCases.preconditions: User is not logged in (no active session).
expectedResults: The user is redirected to the login page
No admin data is displayed
The User & Roles page is not accessible without authentication
The login page loads correctly for the user to authenticate
testCases.postconditions: Unauthenticated access is blocked with redirect to login

testCases.title: Add Internal Admin button is not visible to Limited-Access Admin (if they somehow reach the page)
testCases.preconditions: A Limited-Access Admin has somehow reached the User & Roles page (e.g., via cached page or race condition).
steps: Simulate a Limited-Access Admin viewing the User & Roles page content
expectedResults: The 'Add Internal Admin' button is NOT rendered/visible
The role dropdowns are NOT editable
The 'Edit Permissions' buttons are NOT visible
Even if the page content loads, management controls are hidden based on the user's role
testCases.postconditions: Management controls are hidden for unauthorized users

testCases.title: Multiple Super Admins can independently manage User & Roles
testCases.preconditions: Two Super Admin accounts exist. Both are logged in simultaneously.
steps: Super Admin A logs in and navigates to User & Roles
Super Admin B logs in (different browser/session) and navigates to User & Roles
Both attempt to perform management actions
expectedResults: Both Super Admins can access User & Roles independently
Both can perform management actions (add, edit roles, edit permissions)
Actions by one do not block the other
Changes made by one are visible to the other after refresh
testCases.postconditions: Multiple Super Admins can manage concurrently
